item.title: Trump Kicks Fed Chair Search Back into High Gear
item.description: President Donald Trump is restarting final interviews for the next Federal Reserve chair this week after last week’s abrupt delays in the process.

item.title: Microsoft Unveils Massive $17.5 Billion A.I. Investment in India
item.description: Microsoft announced a $17.5 billion investment in India’s cloud and AI infrastructure over the next four years, marking its largest Asia investment to date.

item.title: Job Openings Stall as Layoffs Rise in a Cooling U.S. Labor Market
item.description: U.S. job openings held nearly steady at 7.7 million in October, indicating continued uncertainty about the direction of the economy.

item.title: SpaceX Eyes Record-Shattering $1.5 Trillion IPO in 2026
item.description: SpaceX is reportedly preparing for a mid-to-late 2026 IPO that aims to raise $30 billion at a staggering $1.5 trillion valuation, according to Bloomberg.

item.title: PepsiCo to Slash Product Line and Cut Prices
item.description: PepsiCo said it will cut nearly 20% of its product offerings and lower prices as part of a new plan shaped by activist investor Elliott Investment Management.

item.title: Rivian Building Its Own A.I. Assistant
item.description: Rivian has spent nearly two years developing an in-house AI assistant, separate from its multibillion-dollar tech partnership with Volkswagen.

item.title: Wall Street flirts with its all-time high after the Fed cuts rates to help the job market
item.description: The U.S. stock market is flirting with its all-time high after the Federal Reserve cut its main interest rate to bolster the job market. The S&P 500 rose 0.8% Wednesday and was on track to squeak past its all-time closing high, which was set in October. The Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed 559 points, and the Nasdaq composite rose 0.4%. item.title: San Francisco woman gives birth in a Waymo self-driving taxi
item.description: Waymo's self-driving taxis have been in the spotlight for both negative and positive reasons. This week, the automated ride-hailing taxis went viral after a San Francisco woman gave birth inside a Waymo taxi while on her way to the hospital. A Waymo spokesperson on Wednesday confirmed the unusual delivery. It said the company's rider support team detected unusual activity inside the vehicle and alerted 911. item.description: The Fed cut rates, sparking market swings. Bill Mann unpacks the decision, the economy’s direction, policy risks, and what investors should know.
